name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-map-removal-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" lists value:cloneWithType, value:fromJsonWithType, value:toString and value:toBalString; it also lists map:remove.
reason: The expected panic removes a field from a map made immutable by cloneReadOnly(). That essential lang.value operation is absent from both the supported library methods and supported langlib method-call lists, so the full asserted behavior is outside subset 10 even though map:remove is supported.
unsupported_constructs: m2.cloneReadOnly() and the resulting immutable-map mutation panic
test_design_notes: The @panic annotation asserts runtime rejection of removal from the cloned readonly map.
